060c5b9a38f366c1511a4f1db967cf18980fbf4c.summary: News report on EU sanctions adopted in February 2025 against people and outlets tied to Russia's war in Ukraine. Named: Lee Chang Ho, whom the EU says heads North Korea's intelligence agency RGB and oversaw cyber units known in the West as Lazarus and Kimsuky. Also covers Russian influence figures, eight Russian media outlets, and US sanctions on two members of the hacktivist group Cyber Army of Russia Reborn (CARR), which carried out low-impact DDoS attacks and compromised industrial systems at a US energy company.
